findings.obs_text: In Jos 7:21 beautiful (H2896A) describes the cloak Achan saw, nine words before the weighing of the gold bar: both are in his list of what he saw and coveted.

In Rom 4:19 and Heb 11:11 faith (G4102G) stands before the considering, as its frame: not weakening in faith when he considered his body, by faith Sarah counted the promiser faithful. WordNet relates the subgroup to this collection through see and respect; the verses pair the considering with faith.
findings.grounds: since she considered him faithful who had promised

findings.obs_text: In Judg 15:3 harm (H7451C, with H0589 and H5973A at the same place) stands three words after in regard to: Samson declares himself innocent toward the Philistines in the harm he will do.
In Ecc 2:11 gained (H3504) stands thirteen words after considered, at the end of what the considering found: nothing to be gained under the sun.
findings.grounds: all was vanity and a striving after wind

findings.obs_text: In 1Pe 5:12 grace (G5485) stands nine words after regard, in what the letter declares: the true grace of God; the regard is of Silvanus as faithful.
findings.grounds: this is the true grace of God

findings.obs_text: In Psa 28:5 build (H1129) stands seven words after regard, in the consequence of not regarding the Lord's works: he will tear them down and not build them up.
In Mar 10:42 called (G4341) stands six words before considered: Jesus calls the disciples to him, then speaks of those considered rulers.

older.finding: Called is here the outward act of summoning, addressing or sending for another person or thing; it bears on the other's response but names no inner-being operation of the one who calls.
older.reason: it states a face or the use of the call words; the call collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Heb 11:26 reproach (G3680) stands directly after considered as what is counted: the reproach of Christ counted greater wealth than Egypt's treasures.
findings.grounds: He considered the reproach of Christ

findings.obs_text: In Ezr 8:29 chief (H8269) stands two words after weigh: the weighing is to be done before the chief priests.
findings.grounds: weigh them before the chief priests

findings.obs_text: In 1Ki 10:21 and 2Ch 9:20 pure (H5462) describes the gold five words before considered: all was of pure gold, and silver was counted as nothing.
In Lev 19:23 forbidden (H6190H, H6189) stands two and six words after regard as what the fruit is to be counted: forbidden for three years.
